title: 📩 Norasmiy xat (Informal/Friendly Letter)
lesson:
📩 *Norasmiy xat — tuzilishi*

1️⃣ *Salomlashish:* Dear [Ism], / Hi [Ism],
2️⃣ *Kirish:* Hol-ahvol so'rash — "How are you? I hope you're doing well."
3️⃣ *Asosiy qism:* Asosiy xabar — do'stona, erkin uslubda, qisqartmalar (I'm, it's) va so'zlashuv iboralari (by the way, guess what) ishlatiladi.
4️⃣ *Yakunlash:* "Looking forward to hearing from you soon." / "Take care,"
5️⃣ *Imzo:* Best wishes, / Love, — so'ng ismingiz

🗣 *Foydali iboralar:*
— It was great to hear from you!
— Sorry I haven't written in a while.
— Guess what happened...
— Anyway, I'd better go now.
— Write back soon!
taskPrompt: ✍ *Vazifa:* Xorijda o'qiyotgan do'stingizga xat yozing — unga yangi ish/loyihangiz haqida so'zlab bering va uni tashrif buyurishga taklif qiling. Kamida 100 so'z.

title: 📄 Rasmiy xat (Formal Letter)
lesson:
📄 *Rasmiy xat — tuzilishi*

1️⃣ *Salomlashish:* Dear Mr./Ms. [Familiya], yoki Dear Sir/Madam, (agar ism noma'lum bo'lsa)
2️⃣ *Kirish:* Xat maqsadini aniq bildiring — "I am writing to inform/request/complain..."
3️⃣ *Asosiy qism:* Har bir paragraf — bitta fikr. Rasmiy uslub: qisqartmalar ishlatilmaydi (I am, emas I'm), "kindly", "please find attached" kabi iboralar.
4️⃣ *Yakunlash:* "I look forward to your response." / "Please do not hesitate to contact me."
5️⃣ *Imzo:* Yours faithfully, (ism noma'lum bo'lsa) / Yours sincerely, (ism ma'lum bo'lsa) — so'ng to'liq ism

🗣 *Foydali iboralar:*
— I am writing to inform you that...
— I would be grateful if you could...
— Please find attached...
— I look forward to hearing from you.
— Should you require further information, please contact me.
taskPrompt: ✍ *Vazifa:* Muassasa ma'muriyatiga xat yozing — talabalar uchun qo'shimcha Business English kursi ochish taklifini bildiring, buning foydalarini asoslang. Kamida 120 so'z.

title: 🔄 Paraphrasing
lesson:
🔄 *Paraphrasing — fikrni boshqa so'zlar bilan ifodalash*

Insholarda savol matnini so'zma-so'z takrorlamaslik kerak — buning o'rniga uni **o'z so'zlaringiz bilan** qayta ifodalaysiz.

*Usullar:*
1️⃣ *Sinonim ishlatish:* important → crucial/essential
2️⃣ *So'z turkumini o'zgartirish:* to decide (fe'l) → decision (ot)
3️⃣ *Gap tuzilishini o'zgartirish:* Active → Passive ("Many people believe..." → "It is widely believed that...")

*Namuna:*
Original: "Many people think that social media has a negative effect on teenagers."
Paraphrase: "It is widely believed that social networking platforms negatively influence young people."
taskPrompt: ✍ *Vazifa:* Quyidagi gapni 2 xil usulda paraphrase qiling: "Companies should invest more in employee training to increase productivity." So'ng shu fikr asosida 3-4 gapli qisqa paragraf yozing.

title: 🔗 Bog'lovchilar (Linking Words)
lesson:
🔗 *Insholarda bog'lovchilar (Linking Words)*

Fikrlarni bir-biriga bog'lash uchun ishlatiladi — matningizni mantiqiy va oqimli qiladi.

*Qo'shimcha fikr:* Furthermore, Moreover, In addition, Also
*Qarama-qarshilik:* However, On the other hand, Nevertheless, Although
*Sabab-natija:* Therefore, As a result, Consequently, Due to
*Misol keltirish:* For example, For instance, Such as
*Xulosa:* In conclusion, To sum up, Overall

*Namuna:*
"Remote work offers flexibility. **However**, it can also lead to isolation. **Therefore**, companies should organize regular team meetings."
taskPrompt: ✍ *Vazifa:* "Advantages and disadvantages of working from home" mavzusida kamida 5 xil bog'lovchi ishlatib, 120 so'zli paragraf yozing.

title: 💡 Fikrni dalillash (Supporting Ideas)
lesson:
💡 *Fikrni dalillar bilan qo'llab-quvvatlash*

Har bir fikringiz **dalil, misol yoki statistika** bilan asoslanishi kerak — aks holda insho zaif ko'rinadi.

*Tuzilma:* Fikr (Topic sentence) → Tushuntirish (Explanation) → Misol/dalil (Example/Evidence)

*Foydali iboralar:*
— This is mainly because...
— A good example of this is...
— Research shows that...
— This can be illustrated by...

*Namuna:*
Fikr: "Small businesses benefit greatly from social media marketing."
Dalil: "This is mainly because it allows them to reach a large audience at a low cost. For example, a local bakery in Termiz increased its sales by 30% after starting an Instagram page."
taskPrompt: ✍ *Vazifa:* "Investing in staff training improves company performance" fikrini oling va uni kamida 2 ta dalil/misol bilan asoslab, paragraf yozing.

title: ⚖ Problem & Solution Essay
lesson:
⚖ *Problem and Solution Essay — tuzilishi*

1️⃣ *Kirish:* Muammoni tanishtiring
2️⃣ *Asosiy qism 1:* Muammo(lar)ni tasvirlang va sabablarini tushuntiring
3️⃣ *Asosiy qism 2:* Yechim(lar)ni taklif qiling, har birini asoslang
4️⃣ *Xulosa:* Fikrlarni umumlashtiring, eng samarali yechimni ta'kidlang

*Foydali iboralar:*
— One of the main problems is...
— This has led to...
— A possible solution would be to...
— This could be addressed by...
— In order to solve this issue...
taskPrompt: ✍ *Vazifa:* "Problem and Solution" formatida insho yozing: "Unemployment among young graduates in Uzbekistan" mavzusida muammoni tasvirlab, 2 ta yechim taklif qiling. Kamida 150 so'z.

title: 🤝 Agree / Disagree Essay
lesson:
🤝 *Agree or Disagree Essay — tuzilishi*

1️⃣ *Kirish:* Mavzuni tanishtiring, o'z pozitsiyangizni bildiring (roziman/rozi emasman)
2️⃣ *Asosiy qism 1:* Birinchi dalil + misol
3️⃣ *Asosiy qism 2:* Ikkinchi dalil + misol
4️⃣ *(Ixtiyoriy) Qarama-qarshi fikr:* Boshqa tomon fikrini qisqa keltirib, nega u kuchsizroq ekanini tushuntiring
5️⃣ *Xulosa:* Pozitsiyangizni qayta tasdiqlang

*Foydali iboralar:*
— I completely/partly agree that...
— From my point of view...
— Although some people argue that..., I believe...
— This view is supported by the fact that...
taskPrompt: ✍ *Vazifa:* Quyidagi fikr bilan roziligingizni/rozi emasligingizni yozing: "Companies should allow employees to work remotely full-time." Kamida 150 so'z, aniq pozitsiya bilan.

title: 📊 Advantages & Disadvantages Essay
lesson:
📊 *Advantages and Disadvantages Essay — tuzilishi*

1️⃣ *Kirish:* Mavzuni tanishtiring (pozitsiya bildirmasdan)
2️⃣ *Asosiy qism 1:* Afzalliklar (kamida 2 ta, dalil bilan)
3️⃣ *Asosiy qism 2:* Kamchiliklar (kamida 2 ta, dalil bilan)
4️⃣ *Xulosa:* Umumiy balansni bildiring — qaysi tomon ustunroq deb hisoblaysiz

*Foydali iboralar:*
— One major advantage/benefit of... is that...
— On the other hand, a significant drawback is...
— Despite these benefits/drawbacks...
— Weighing up both sides, it seems that...
taskPrompt: ✍ *Vazifa:* "Advantages and disadvantages of outsourcing business functions" mavzusida insho yozing — kamida 2 afzallik, 2 kamchilik va xulosa bilan. Kamida 150 so'z.

title: 🆚 Comparison Essay ("Is it better...?")
lesson:
🆚 *Comparison Essay — tuzilishi*

Ikki narsani (masalan, ikki usul, ikki tanlov) solishtirib, qaysi biri afzalroq ekanini asoslaysiz.

1️⃣ *Kirish:* Ikkala variantni tanishtiring
2️⃣ *Asosiy qism 1:* Birinchi variant — afzallik/kamchiliklari
3️⃣ *Asosiy qism 2:* Ikkinchi variant — afzallik/kamchiliklari
4️⃣ *Xulosa:* Qaysi biri afzalroq ekanini aniq bildiring va sababini tushuntiring

*Foydali iboralar:*
— Compared to..., ... is...
— Unlike..., ... offers...
— Both options have their merits, however...
— All things considered, ... is the better choice because...
taskPrompt: ✍ *Vazifa:* "Is it better to work for a large corporation or a small startup?" mavzusida ikkalasini solishtirib, xulosa bilan insho yozing. Kamida 150 so'z.
